data_quality_caveat: yfinance current-IWM-holdings universe -> SURVIVORSHIP BIAS (delisted/dropped names excluded; we used current static IWM membership applied retroactively to 2018-2025). Adjusted close used for both signal and P&L; open adjusted via close-ratio (approx). Top-N by trailing 20d dollar ADV. NO earnings/PDUFA/HTB filters applied — those gates from the spec are unavailable from yfinance. We filtered ~7 trades with |overnight return| > 25% as corp-action/split artifacts (yfinance bar inconsistencies). Edge is almost certainly OVERSTATED vs. a point-in-time universe — published academic Sharpe for this anomaly is typically 0.4-0.8 on point-in-time data with realistic slippage; our 1.5+ OOS rolling Sharpe is consistent with the survivorship-bias uplift expected.
